sn35.130:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati kuraraghare pavatte pabbate.
sn35.130:1.2: atha kho hāliddakāni gahapati yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho hāliddakāni gahapati āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.130:1.4: “dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānatta”nti.
sn35.130:1.5: kathannu kho bhante dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattanti.
sn35.130:1.6: idha gahapati, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā manāpaṃ itthetanti pajānāti. cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sukhavedanīyañca
sn35.130:1.8: cakkhunā kho paneva rūpaṃ disvā amanāpaṃ itthetanti pajānāti, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhavedanīyañca
sn35.130:1.10: cakkhunā paneva rūpaṃ disvā upekhāṭhānīyaṃ itthetanti pajānāti. cakkhuviññāṇaṃ adukkhamasukha vedanīyañca
sn35.130:2.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe…
sn35.130:2.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya manāpaṃ itthetanti pajānāti, manoviññāṇaṃ sukhavedaniyañca
sn35.130:2.7: manasā kho paneva dhammaṃ viññāya amanāpaṃ itthetanti pajānāti, manoviññāṇaṃ dukkhavedaniyañca
sn35.130:2.9: manasā kho paneva dhammaṃ viññāya upekhāṭhānīyaṃ itthetanti pajānāti. manoviññāṇaṃ adukkhamasukhavedanīyañca
sn35.130:2.11: evaṃ kho gahapati dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattanti.
